personalInfo.location: Tagaytay City, Cavite, Philippines · Available Remote

about: CRM and email marketing strategist with a focus on lifecycle campaigns that keep revenue steady between big promotions. I design and maintain Klaviyo and Mailchimp flows, write direct-response copy, and lean on testing rather than guesswork to improve open and click performance. Over the past several years I've supported DTC brands in the US and Australia, balancing hands-on template building with the reporting side — tracking what a flow actually contributes to revenue, not just how it looks.

experience.description: Managing full lifecycle email programs for two DTC brands, from flow strategy through campaign calendar and reporting.
details: Rebuilt core Klaviyo flows (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase) resulting in a 29% lift in flow-attributed revenue
Introduced quarterly A/B testing cadence across subject lines and send times, raising average open rate from 34% to 46%
Built and maintained segmentation logic across 6 customer lifecycle stages
Delivered monthly performance reports tying email activity directly to store revenue
